headline: Binance wins a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order over its October hack

scenes.vo: Binance just got a court order to freeze up to six and a half billion dollars, worldwide, tied to its October hack. Here's what changed.
Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts granted a worldwide freezing order against the unknown attackers. It covers a living list of about twenty six thousand wallets holding stolen funds.
Here's why traders are watching it. The order can be served on chain, so exchanges and stablecoin issuers have a court order to hold or hand back frozen funds.
The catch. Six and a half billion is what the order covers, not what's been recovered. The attackers are still unidentified, and funds keep moving.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether exchanges and issuers start releasing frozen funds under this order, and how the wallet list changes.
